candidate.name: source_field_reorder_phase_parallel_r9
candidate.single_mechanism_variable: retain four supplier TP fields and overlap independently source-derived opposite-polarity BW/WB VS fields in those shared phases

encoding_proof.reason: TP[nX] is shared phase timing, while VS[nX-LUTm] is independently encoded for every LUT m; LUT1 BW and LUT2 WB can therefore select VSH1 and VSL simultaneously in the same retained phase.
encoding_proof.bit_order: each LUT byte packs A in D7:D6, B in D5:D4, C in D3:D2, D in D1:D0

r4_to_r9_comparison.correction_to_prior_shorthand: R4 has eight shared timing frames in each polarity half; exact VS decoding yields 12 effective BW drive frames and 14 effective WB drive frames, not eight effective frames per transition.

busy_prediction.basis: R9 and R4 both use groups 0..3, zero SR/RP, supplier-exact FR/XON/tail and exactly 16 shared TP frames; R4 measured 598..599 ms. Voltage selection does not add gate frames.
